q: What does a vision-language-action model output?
options: Robot actions such as joint or gripper commands
explain: It maps observations and instructions to actions.

q: Why do embodied systems often use a planner plus a low-level policy?
options: Thinking and moving run on different time scales; control needs many commands per second
Behavior learned in simulation failing to transfer to real robots
explain: Friction, lighting and noise differ in reality.
